🚨 $SPCX - JPMORGAN DOUBLES SPACEX PRICE TARGET TO $500 JPMorgan raised its SpaceX price target from $240 to $500, maintaining an Overweight rating. The bank now forecasts $254 billion in 2027 revenue and 10 GW of computing capacity by year-end, more than doubling its 2027–2028 estimates. JPMorgan also sees strategic merit in a potential SpaceX–Tesla merger, though no deal is guaranteed.

🚨 $SPCX - CITI FLAGS SPACEX AS A 90-DAY UPSIDE CATALYST Citi has added SpaceX to its 90-day upside catalyst watch list. Shares surged 8.21% overnight following the company's earnings release. Since its reported June 2026 IPO at $150, the stock is up 8.14% year-to-date.

🚨 TRUMP THANKS ELON MUSK FOR SPACEX STOCK GIVEAWAY President Trump praised Elon Musk for pledging SpaceX shares to millions of American children through Trump Accounts. Trump called the initiative a major step toward giving children a stake in the American Dream.

🚨 MUSK TO RENAME SPACEXAI AS “SPACEXSI” Elon Musk says he will rename SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI, adopting President Trump’s push to replace “artificial intelligence” with “super intelligence.” Musk confirmed the change on X, saying “Yes, we will make that change,” but provided no timeline. The company’s X account had not yet been renamed at the time of publication.
